description: Use this when the user wants a private chauffeur, airport transfer or long-distance car in or from Madrid and you know the route, date and time: it returns the vehicles available for that exact trip with the final price (EUR, VAT, tolls, parking and Meet & Greet included) and shows them to the user as cards with a Book button. Read-only, nothing is saved. Prices are closed fares from the rate card per real road kilometre, never estimates; when a trip needs a person the answer says so instead of inventing a price. The pickup must respect the minimum notice (Madrid time). Follow with create_booking to book.

addons.description: Paid extras. Meet & Greet (welcome with a name board) is always included: do not pass it.

date.description: Pickup date, YYYY-MM-DD, Madrid calendar date.

destination.description: Drop-off location. For a chauffeur at disposal (SRV_DISPOSITION) pass it ONLY if the service ends somewhere other than the Madrid region: it then adds the drive back to Madrid. If the service ends in Madrid, or the user only named the area where they will be, omit it and use dispositionArea.

dispositionArea.description: Main area or destination of an at-disposal service.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".

oneWayOrRoundTrip.description: round_trip = the passenger goes and comes back: two services, each direction measured and priced separately (outbound + return, with the return priced at the outbound date and time). Booked as two one-way bookings.

origin.description: Pickup location (address, airport terminal, hotel, station). Be specific: "Aeropuerto Madrid-Barajas T4", "Hotel Ritz Madrid".

serviceType.description: Optional: inferred when omitted (transfer or long distance from the route; disposal when hours/days are given).

time.description: Pickup time, 24h HH:MM, Madrid wall-clock time.
